predictions: Ok, now THAT was a good week. We don't have one result yet, so the record isn't quite final yet, but so far I'm 19-6 in last week's matches. And while I did get 6 wrong, all 6 of those ended up 13-11 or 14-10, so I was probably about one dart from winning or tying all those picks too. Nice. That brings me to 147-64 (69.7% correct) so far, and that percentage would rise to about 75% if we just kicked F division out…

Match of the week: (E Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Runs with Corks. It's entirely possible that What's the Point will run away with the E title. But the race for 2nd (and a potential climb to D next season) is a hotly contested one. With the Corks taking out the Blanks last week, the winner here will be alone one match out of 2nd. Corks in the last 501.

Match #2: (F Div.) Death Throw @ That's What She Said. As I've been saying for a month, every last match in F could be critical. DT is on the brink of taking the F lead, but they are simultaneously only two matches from being passed by 5th place She Said. It's only 3 matches from first to last in this mess. Feels like yet another 1001… Death Throw.

Match #3: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Dart Attack. With Attack's win over Wing last week, the fight to finish as one of the top four teams in the entire league's became a newly invigorated battle royals. Four teams separated by 1 match and 7 points!! Darty Minds move up, 15-9.

Match #4: (B Div.) Angry Birds @ The Kids who say "Ni!" The Kids are on an absolute heater, winning 6 in a row and taking the B lead. But the Birds are on a run too, turning an 0-3 start into a 4-3 grab of 3rd place Supreme matchup here. I'm stick with the Kids, but nervously. 13-11.

Match #5: (C Div.) Mulligans Mafia @ Area 501. Area hasn't lost in a couple seasons now, so the Mafia has a tall task here. But if they do manage to pull the upset, they could quickly find themselves in 2nd place (and joining Area in B next season). Alas, this is still Area, 14-10.

Match #6: (F Div.) Nein Mark @ Two Time. One of these teams might finish in a bottom-two slot and maybe fall to G. Or that same team might finish in a top-two slot and climb to E. And the same is true for the other too. Welcome to F-land (not Efland). Nein Mark, 13-11.

Match #7: (H Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Dirty Darts (Done Dirt Cheap). There is a missing result, but it's possible this is a head-to- head for 3rd place in H. I think I'll look on the Bright Side here, 15-9.
Match #8: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Double In Stumble Out. The five-pack-battle of D teams fighting to avoid those bottom-two spots continues weekly. I'll take the Bandits' 501 edge for a 13-11.
Match #9: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Flight Club. The last few weeks have opened doors in the G race. Winner of this sits in 3rd and keeps their shot at claiming G alive. We Throw It, 13-11.

Match #10: (C Div.) Still Hump'N @ Pints and Points. Ok, let's not sugarcoat this one… Is this Hump'N's best shot at getting off this season's winless list? Probably. But I think the Pints escape, 14-10.

Matches #11 & #12: (B Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Only Darts; Bottoms Up @ Liquor Possee. The bottom two in B sit two matches behind the pair of teams ahead of them. If they want to get out of those bottom slots, picking off those directly ahead is key. In the end, both get away though. Inconsistent, 14-10; Possee, 16-8.
